name: Light Rain
onset: A few isolated taps, then more, until the air itself seems to whisper.
sustain: A steady, irregular patter — each drop its own small percussion, the collective a soft static hiss.
decay: The drops thin, space out, and then one final tap before silence reclaims the air.

prose_fragments: the gentlest percussion section in nature
each drop a tiny detonation on leaf or stone
a sound like the sky thinking out loud
experiential.feel: intimate, meditative, a sound that makes indoors feel more indoor

name: Heavy Rain
onset: It arrives like a curtain dropped — one moment drizzle, the next a wall of water-sound.
sustain: A constant broadband roar, individual drops lost in the collective assault, the world reduced to this one enormous sound.
decay: The roar loosens, separates back into individual drops, each one suddenly audible again as the mass retreats.

prose_fragments: the sky emptying itself all at once
a roar that erases thought
white noise made by a billion tiny impacts
experiential.feel: overwhelming, cleansing, the world simplified to water and sound

name: Rain on Tin Roof
onset: The first drops ring out like tiny bells struck at random, each one sharp and bright.
sustain: A continuous metallic patter, amplified and resonant, every drop given a voice by the thin metal membrane.
decay: The ringing thins, each drop a distinct metallic ping again, then silence between the last few taps.

prose_fragments: nature's typewriter, hammering out randomness on a metal page
every drop amplified, given weight and presence by the tin
the sound of shelter made audible
experiential.feel: cozy and primal, the thin barrier between you and the storm singing

name: Distant Thunder
onset: A low growl at the horizon, almost felt before it's heard.
sustain: It rolls across the sky, a long slow tumble of bass that seems to use the clouds as a corridor.
decay: The rumble weakens into a murmur, then a vibration, then a memory the bones hold longer than the ears.

prose_fragments: the sky clearing its throat
a sound that belongs to the belly more than the ears
the atmosphere reminding you of its weight
experiential.feel: primal unease, a reminder of scale

name: Close Thunder
onset: A crack that splits the air — no warning, no build, just sudden violence of sound.
sustain: The crack blooms into a rolling boom that shakes windows and rattles the chest.
decay: The boom rolls away in diminishing waves, each echo softer, the air slowly stitching itself back together.

prose_fragments: the sky breaking open
sound as concussion — you feel it in your teeth
a detonation of pure atmosphere
experiential.feel: shock, awe, the sudden smallness of being human

name: Gentle Breeze
onset: It arrives as a suggestion — a slight pressure on the ear before the sound registers.
sustain: A soft, continuous sigh, rising and falling in long slow waves like breathing.
decay: It subsides into stillness so gradually you can't name the moment it stopped.

prose_fragments: the air moving just enough to have a voice
a sound like the earth exhaling
the gentlest thing that moves
experiential.feel: peaceful, alive, the sound of nothing happening beautifully

name: Gusty Wind
onset: It hits in a sudden rush — a wall of moving air that presses everything sideways.
sustain: Surges and retreats in rough, irregular waves, whistling through gaps, howling around corners.
decay: One last gust, then a pause that feels like the wind catching its breath before the next assault.

prose_fragments: air with intention and force
the wind arguing with architecture
a sound that pushes back
experiential.feel: raw, exposed, the world in motion

name: Ocean Waves
onset: The wave gathers — a rising hiss of displaced water rushing shoreward.
sustain: The crash, then the long hissing retreat of foam over sand, already the next wave building behind it.
decay: The hiss thins to a whisper as the water pulls back, a moment of near-silence before the next surge.

prose_fragments: the oldest rhythm on Earth
each wave a breath the ocean takes and releases
the sound of time measured in water
experiential.feel: hypnotic, ancient, the metronome of the planet

name: Dawn Birdsong
onset: One bird. A single tentative phrase in the dark. Then another answers, and another, until the air is woven with song.
sustain: A dense, layered tapestry of calls and responses — trills, whistles, chips — each voice distinct but the whole greater than any part.
decay: As the sun climbs, the urgency fades. Songs space out, become casual, background. The chorus dissolves into soloists.

prose_fragments: the alarm clock that existed before time
the world tuning itself to the key of morning
a hundred tiny throats competing for the light
experiential.feel: hopeful, urgent, the sound of the world waking up and being glad about it

name: Cricket Chorus
onset: It begins with a single chirp, then another joins, then dozens, until the night pulses with them.
sustain: A steady, rhythmic pulsation — almost mechanical in its regularity, the temperature made audible.
decay: As cold creeps in, the rhythm slows, the chirps space out, each one a little lonelier than the last.

prose_fragments: the night's pulse, taken in chirps
tiny violinists sawing away at the darkness
the sound that means summer is still here
experiential.feel: warm, nostalgic, the acoustic wallpaper of summer nights

name: Rustling Leaves
onset: A breeze stirs and the canopy responds — a soft susurrus rising from a thousand leaves.
sustain: A continuous papery whisper, each leaf a tiny flag snapping in the air.
decay: The breeze passes and the sound settles like falling confetti — a few last clicks, then stillness.

prose_fragments: applause from an audience of leaves
the sound of restlessness in something rooted
a thousand small dry things speaking at once
experiential.feel: natural, calming, the sound trees make when they remember they can move

name: Flowing Stream
onset: You hear it before you see it — a liquid murmur threading through the ambient silence.
sustain: An endlessly varied conversation of water with stone — bubbling, trickling, splashing in an unrepeating pattern.
decay: As you walk away, the detail dissolves. The babble simplifies to a hush, then nothing.

prose_fragments: water explaining itself to rocks
the most patient sound in nature
liquid music, never the same phrase twice
experiential.feel: peaceful, alive, the sound of persistence

name: Waterfall
onset: It announces itself from far away — a growing roar that fills the valley before you round the bend.
sustain: A constant, thundering wall of white noise — water in freefall, smashing against rock, atomizing into mist and sound.
decay: You don't hear it stop. You walk away and it diminishes, like turning down the volume on geology.

prose_fragments: gravity given a voice
water committing itself to the fall
the roar of a river deciding to become rain again
experiential.feel: awesome, humbling, the sound of force without malice

name: Ambient Traffic
onset: It doesn't start. It's already there. The city's permanent bass note.
sustain: A layered wash of tire noise, engine hum, and the doppler-shifted whoosh of passing vehicles.
decay: Only at 3 AM does it thin enough to notice the gaps. Even then, a distant truck reminds you.

prose_fragments: the city's circulatory system, heard from outside the body
movement abstracted into a continuous roar
the sound of a million journeys overlapping
experiential.feel: urban, anonymous, the background radiation of civilization

name: Emergency Siren
onset: A distant wail, growing — the pitch climbing and falling in that two-tone urgency.
sustain: The siren fills the street, bouncing off buildings, impossible to ignore — the sound equivalent of red.
decay: It passes, the pitch dropping as it goes — doppler pulling the wail down into a receding moan.

prose_fragments: urgency compressed into a waveform
the sound that makes everyone stop and look
a wail that parts traffic like a knife
experiential.feel: anxiety, urgency, someone else's emergency touching your nervous system

name: Subway Train
onset: First the wind — pushed ahead of the train through the tunnel. Then the rumble, growing, felt in the platform underfoot.
sustain: A screaming rush of metal on metal, wind blast, the roar of displacement in a concrete tube.
decay: Brakes bite — a metallic shriek, then the sudden near-silence of the stopped train, just the hiss of doors.

prose_fragments: a metal serpent screaming through a stone throat
the commute distilled to noise and wind
underground thunder with scheduled stops
experiential.feel: overwhelming, industrial, the sound of infrastructure doing violence to silence

name: Construction Site
onset: The jackhammer starts without preamble — a staccato assault that sets the teeth on edge.
sustain: Overlapping chaos: hammering, drilling, the beep of reversing vehicles, shouted instructions, metal on metal.
decay: A brief silence. Then it starts again. The pauses only make the next assault more jarring.

prose_fragments: the city remodeling itself, loudly
organized destruction set to no rhythm
every tool competing for most annoying
experiential.feel: intrusive, relentless, the sound of progress at the expense of peace

name: Footsteps on Concrete
onset: A heel strikes concrete — a sharp, clean report that announces intention.
sustain: The steady beat of sole on stone, metronomic and purposeful, each step a small declaration.
decay: The steps thin with distance, their sharpness softened by air until they merge with the ambient.

prose_fragments: the tempo of someone with somewhere to be
each step a small certainty on hard ground
the most human rhythm imposed on the urban surface
experiential.feel: purposeful, urban, the sound of intention

name: Footsteps on Gravel
onset: The first step crunches — a complex sound of a hundred tiny stones grinding and shifting.
sustain: Each step a small avalanche, the crunch slightly different every time, the gravel never settling the same way twice.
decay: The crunching stops and a few last stones click and settle, then silence.

prose_fragments: walking on a surface that talks back
the ground protesting every step
a hundred tiny stones rearranging themselves under each footfall
experiential.feel: textured, rural, the sound of ground that won't be ignored

name: Footsteps on Wood Floor
onset: A warm, hollow knock as weight meets wood — the floor announcing a presence.
sustain: Each step resonates through the boards, warm and slightly hollow, the occasional creak adding character.
decay: The resonance dies quickly — wood absorbs its own echoes, leaving a brief, warm silence.

prose_fragments: the sound of home, literally underfoot
wood remembering the tree it was, vibrating with each step
a warm percussion that old houses play for free
experiential.feel: domestic, warm, the sound of a floor that has stories

name: Creaking Door
onset: The hinge protests — a slow, rising groan that seems to come from the wood itself.
sustain: A long, wavering creak as the door swings, the pitch shifting with the angle.
decay: The creak ends with a final squeak as the door reaches its limit, then silence.

prose_fragments: a hinge that has forgotten what oil is
the door complaining about being asked to move
a sound that horror movies didn't invent, just borrowed
experiential.feel: old, slightly eerie, the voice of neglected metal and warped wood

name: Door Slam
onset: A sharp, definitive bang — the air displaced in a sudden compression.
sustain: Almost none. The impact is the message.
decay: The frame rattles briefly, then the house absorbs the shock and is still.

prose_fragments: punctuation for an argument
the sound of a decision made in anger
a period at the end of a sentence slammed down hard
experiential.feel: final, emphatic, a sound that ends conversations

name: Elevator Ding
onset: A single, pure tone — bright and deliberate, designed to be heard without being noticed.
sustain: None. The ding is complete in itself.
decay: A brief shimmer of overtones, then gone.

prose_fragments: the most polite sound in architecture
a tiny bell marking the arrival of a small room
the sound of vertical travel, announced
experiential.feel: neutral, informational, the sound of waiting rewarded

name: Kettle Boiling
onset: A quiet ticking of metal expanding, then the first whispers of heat meeting water.
sustain: A growing roar — bubbles forming, collapsing, reforming — the pitch rising as the water approaches the boil.
decay: The click of the switch, and the roar drops to a settling murmur, then to ticking silence.

prose_fragments: water getting excited about becoming steam
the domestic overture to a cup of tea
a small, contained violence in the kitchen
experiential.feel: homely, anticipatory, the sound of comfort being prepared

name: Clock Ticking
onset: You don't notice it starting. You notice it's been there all along.
sustain: Tick. Tock. Tick. Tock. The most regular sound a room can hold — time being measured out in tiny portions.
decay: It doesn't decay. You stop hearing it. Then silence brings it back, louder than ever.

prose_fragments: time audible, portioned into seconds
the heartbeat of an empty room
a sound that only exists when you're not doing anything else
experiential.feel: patient, relentless, the sound of time passing and not caring

name: Refrigerator Hum
onset: The compressor kicks in with a low shudder, then settles into its familiar drone.
sustain: A constant, low hum — the mechanical mantra of cold being maintained, a drone that inhabits the kitchen.
decay: The compressor clicks off and the silence rushes in so fast you realize how loud it was all along.

prose_fragments: the kitchen's baseline frequency
a drone so constant it becomes a kind of silence
the sound of electricity keeping things fresh
experiential.feel: background, domestic, the sound you only hear when it stops

name: Keys Jingling
onset: A sudden bright scatter of metal on metal — tiny collisions producing a miniature chaos of tones.
sustain: A brief, complex shimmer as the keys swing and settle against each other.
decay: The jingling dies to a few last clicks as momentum runs out.

prose_fragments: a tiny orchestra warming up in your pocket
access and ownership compressed into a jangle
the sound of leaving or arriving
experiential.feel: bright, transitional, the sound of going somewhere

name: Keyboard Typing
onset: The first few keystrokes, tentative, then a sudden burst as the thought arrives.
sustain: A rapid-fire patter of plastic on plastic, each key a small commitment, the rhythm revealing the writer's certainty.
decay: A pause. The thought finishes. The keys fall silent. Then a single, decisive Enter.

prose_fragments: thought translated to percussion
ideas arriving at the speed of fingers
the sound of language being manufactured one letter at a time
experiential.feel: productive, focused, the clatter of the modern quill

name: Phone Ringing
onset: The first ring breaks whatever silence was there — sudden, sharp, impossible to ignore.
sustain: Ring, pause, ring, pause — a rhythm designed by engineers to be impossible to tune out.
decay: It stops — either answered or abandoned. The silence after feels different from the silence before.

prose_fragments: a demand wearing the disguise of a question
someone wanting your attention from far away
the sound that invented the concept of being interrupted
experiential.feel: urgent, intrusive, the sound of the outside world reaching in

name: Creaking Floorboard
onset: Weight shifts and the board answers — a slow, wooden groan rising from below.
sustain: A brief complaint from the floor, the pitch bending as the weight settles.
decay: The creak resolves with a final tick as the wood finds its new position.

prose_fragments: the house remembering where you stepped
wood admitting it has limits
the floor betraying your presence to the whole house
experiential.feel: intimate, slightly guilty, the sound of trying to be quiet and failing

name: Quiet Breathing
onset: You don't notice it until you listen for it — then it's the loudest thing in the room.
sustain: In, out. In, out. The softest, most fundamental rhythm. The proof of life, metered.
decay: It doesn't decay. It just becomes part of the silence again, like it was always there.

prose_fragments: the most intimate sound a body makes
air being borrowed and returned
the rhythm everything else is built on top of
experiential.feel: intimate, alive, the sound of being present

name: Heartbeat
onset: Press your ear to a chest and there it is — the double-knock that means everything.
sustain: Lub-dub. Lub-dub. Two sounds per beat, the valves opening and closing, seventy times a minute.
decay: You lift your ear and it vanishes back inside the body that owns it.

prose_fragments: the drum that plays from before birth to the last moment
the original rhythm section
a sound that means alive and nothing else
experiential.feel: primal, reassuring, the metronomic proof of existence

name: Laughter
onset: It erupts — sudden, involuntary, the body's surprise response to delight.
sustain: Cascading, rolling, each burst triggering the next, the pitch and rhythm as unique as a fingerprint.
decay: It trails off into smaller aftershocks — a chuckle, a gasp, a final exhale that still holds the shape of a smile.

prose_fragments: joy given sound and set loose
the body's way of saying something is right with the world
a sound that heals the room it's in
experiential.feel: warm, infectious, the sound of being human and finding it funny

name: Whisper
onset: A rush of breath shaped into words — the consonants sharp, the vowels almost vanishing.
sustain: Words carried on breath alone, no voice behind them — pure air shaped by lips and tongue.
decay: The whisper trails into a breath, then into the silence it was hiding in.

prose_fragments: language stripped to its bones — breath and intention
a sound that creates its own private space
words that only travel a few inches
experiential.feel: intimate, conspiratorial, the sound of trust measured in proximity

name: Crowd Murmur
onset: It builds as people gather — a rising hum of conversation where no single voice distinguishes itself.
sustain: A warm, continuous wash of human voices, words blurred into a collective murmur, like a river of language.
decay: The crowd thins and the murmur unravels — individual voices briefly audible before they too disappear.

prose_fragments: a hundred conversations braided into a single sound
the sonic equivalent of a crowd seen from a distance — all motion, no detail
humanity reduced to a warm, unintelligible hum
experiential.feel: social, anonymous, the sound of belonging without participating

name: Applause
onset: It starts ragged — a few pairs of hands, then more, then suddenly everyone, and it's a roar.
sustain: A wall of clapping, broadband noise made from a thousand paired impacts — chaotic but unified in purpose.
decay: It thins unevenly — some hands drop away, others persist, and the last few clappers echo in the silence.

prose_fragments: approval made percussive
a room full of people turning their hands into instruments of gratitude
the noise of consensus, rough and beautiful
experiential.feel: affirming, collective, the sound of many people agreeing about one thing

name: Echoing Footsteps
onset: A heel strikes stone and the echo answers from every wall — a conversation between step and space.
sustain: Each footfall doubled, tripled by the reflections, the walker accompanied by their own ghost-steps.
decay: The last step hangs in the air, its echoes repeating and fading like ripples in a stone corridor.

prose_fragments: one person sounding like a procession
the architecture counting your steps
loneliness made audible by reverb
experiential.feel: solitary, dramatic, the sound of one person in too much space

name: Piano
onset: The hammer strikes the string — a precise, bright attack that blooms instantly into tone.
sustain: The string vibrates, the soundboard amplifies, and the note hangs in the air — rich with harmonics, slowly dimming.
decay: The note fades in a long, even diminuendo, the harmonics dropping away one by one until only the fundamental whispers.

prose_fragments: a hammer asking a string to sing
88 keys, each one a door to a different room of sound
the most complete instrument — percussion, melody, and harmony in one box
experiential.feel: expressive, complete, the sound of music in its most self-sufficient form

name: Violin
onset: The bow touches the string and the tone emerges — not struck but drawn out, pulled into being.
sustain: A continuous, singing tone that can swell and diminish, vibrate and glide — the closest an instrument comes to a human voice.
decay: The bow lifts and the note ends — not fading but ceasing, like a voice choosing silence.

prose_fragments: a voice without words
wood and gut and horsehair conspiring to make you feel things
the instrument that can cry
experiential.feel: emotional, human, the sound that finds the feelings you didn't know you had

name: Acoustic Guitar
onset: The finger plucks and the string snaps to life — a bright attack softened immediately by the wooden body.
sustain: The body resonates, warming the tone, the sound breathing with the wood's own character.
decay: The note rings and diminishes, the wood soaking up the vibration until only a ghost of the tone remains.

prose_fragments: a box of air and wood that amplifies longing
six strings and a hollow body — the campfire instrument
warmth and intimacy in a portable package
experiential.feel: intimate, warm, the sound of one person making music for a small room

name: Drums
onset: The stick hits the skin — an instant, explosive report, felt as much as heard.
sustain: The drum head vibrates, the shell resonates, a brief bloom of tone colored by the drum's size and material.
decay: Quick — the energy dissipates into the drumhead and shell. A snare buzzes briefly. A tom rumbles and dies.

prose_fragments: the original instrument — skin stretched over hollow
rhythm made physical, felt in the chest
the backbone of every music that makes you move
experiential.feel: primal, physical, the sound that turns listening into movement

name: Church Bell
onset: The clapper strikes bronze and the metal detonates into sound — a massive, complex chord from a single impact.
sustain: The bell rings with overtones layered on overtones, the bronze singing a chord no single note could contain.
decay: A long, shimmering fade — the overtones dropping away in layers, the fundamental persisting, the bell humming to itself for half a minute after the strike.

prose_fragments: time marked in bronze
a single strike that contains a whole chord
the sound that has called humans together for a thousand years
experiential.feel: solemn, communal, the sound of time and tradition made audible

name: Wind Chimes
onset: A breeze stirs and the tubes begin to knock and ring — random, bright, like a tiny bell choir conducted by the wind.
sustain: An irregular scatter of bright tones, each collision different, the wind composing in real time.
decay: The breeze dies and the chimes slow to occasional taps, then a final, solitary ring hanging in the still air.

prose_fragments: the wind's own instrument, playing whatever it wants
randomness that sounds like intention
tiny metal tubes translating air into music
experiential.feel: peaceful, random, the sound of letting the wind decide

name: Engine Idling
onset: The engine turns over and catches — a rough cough settling into a steady, low rumble.
sustain: A constant, vibrating drone — the combustion cycle reduced to a felt hum, slightly uneven, slightly alive.
decay: The key turns, the engine coughs once, and the silence that replaces it feels vast.

prose_fragments: controlled explosions at idle speed
a machine breathing in its sleep
potential energy humming in place
experiential.feel: patient, mechanical, the sound of power restrained

name: Ceiling Fan
onset: A click, then the blades begin to turn — a low whoosh building as they reach speed.
sustain: A steady, rhythmic whooshing — the blades cutting air in a circle, each pass a soft pulse of moving air.
decay: The fan slows and the whoosh drops in pitch, the pauses between blade-passes growing until you can count them.

prose_fragments: the laziest machine in the house
air being stirred in slow circles
the sound of summer not quite being enough
experiential.feel: lazy, comfortable, the sound of making do with moving air

name: Air Conditioning Hum
onset: The unit clicks on with a shudder, then the hum settles in like a roommate who doesn't talk.
sustain: A constant, slightly textured hum — fan and compressor blending into a wall of background sound.
decay: It cycles off and the room suddenly sounds twice as large. You hear everything you'd been missing.

prose_fragments: comfort's monotone
the modern cave's mechanical breath
a sound that air-conditions silence as well as air
experiential.feel: background, artificial, the sound of climate being controlled

name: Train on Tracks
onset: The first clack — wheels meeting a rail joint — then another, and a rhythm establishes itself.
sustain: Clack-clack, clack-clack — the joints in the rail marking distance in a steady, hypnotic meter, the car swaying gently.
decay: The train slows and the rhythm stretches — longer gaps between the clacks, the tempo winding down like a clock running out.

prose_fragments: distance being measured in rhythmic metal clicks
the oldest mass-transit lullaby
a rhythm that could rock you to sleep if you let it
experiential.feel: hypnotic, nostalgic, the sound of going somewhere at a pace that lets you think

name: Glass Clinking
onset: Glass meets glass — a bright, pure tone that rings out clean and sharp.
sustain: A brief shimmer of harmonics, the glass vibrating at its natural frequency.
decay: The ring fades quickly but clearly, like a bell in miniature.

prose_fragments: a tiny celebration in crystallized sound
the sound of something about to be drunk to
glass remembering it was once sand
experiential.feel: celebratory, bright, the sound of a moment being marked

name: Crackling Fire
onset: The first pop — a pocket of sap or moisture bursting in the heat. Then another.
sustain: A continuous, irregular percussion of snaps, crackles, and pops — the wood surrendering its moisture to the flame.
decay: As the fire burns down to embers, the crackles space out, each one quieter, the conversation between wood and flame winding down.

prose_fragments: wood telling its secrets to the fire
the original podcast — random, warm, hypnotic
a sound that has kept humans company since the beginning
experiential.feel: primal, comforting, the sound of safety in the darkness

name: Espresso Machine
onset: The pump engages with a rising hum, pressure building — then the first hiss of steam.
sustain: A pressurized gurgle as water is forced through coffee at nine bars — the hiss, the sputter, the liquid sound of extraction.
decay: The pump winds down, a final sputter of steam, then dripping silence.

prose_fragments: pressure and heat conspiring to extract flavor from a bean
the morning's most important machine, working
a small industrial process performed in the name of caffeine
experiential.feel: anticipatory, ritual, the sound of morning becoming functional

name: Rain Against Window
onset: The first drops hit the glass with a light tap — bright, percussive, amplified by the pane.
sustain: An irregular patter against the glass, each drop a tiny bright impact, rivulets forming and racing each other down the surface.
decay: The taps thin to occasional single drops that hit with exaggerated clarity in the returning quiet.

prose_fragments: the outside world knocking on the glass
rain turned into percussion by a window pane
the sound of inside and outside negotiating through a thin transparent wall
experiential.feel: cozy, contemplative, the sound of being dry near wetness

name: Falling Snow
onset: There is no onset. Snow arrives in silence. But the silence itself changes — grows thicker, more padded.
sustain: The absence of sound becomes a presence. Snow absorbs everything — footsteps, voices, traffic — wrapping the world in acoustic cotton.
decay: When it stops, the silence remains, deeper than before. The world sounds different under its white blanket.

prose_fragments: the loudest silence nature can produce
sound being erased flake by flake
the world putting itself on mute
experiential.feel: hushed, reverent, the sound of the world being made new and quiet

name: Rustling Paper
onset: A page turns — a crisp, dry whisper of fiber against fiber.
sustain: Brief — the paper flexes, rustles, settles. Each page a slightly different sound depending on weight and texture.
decay: A final settling whisper as the page lies flat.

prose_fragments: the sound of information being accessed the old way
trees turned to pages turning to knowledge
a dry whisper that smells of ink
experiential.feel: quiet, studious, the sound of attention being paid

name: Cat Purring
onset: It starts like a tiny engine turning over — a low, felt vibration more than a heard sound.
sustain: A continuous, rhythmic rumble — the whole body vibrating at 25 Hz, the sound of contentment made mechanical.
decay: It fades as sleep deepens, the rumble thinning to occasional pulses, then silence.

prose_fragments: a small warm engine running on contentment
the frequency of healing, according to veterinary science
the sound a cat makes when the world is exactly right
experiential.feel: soothing, warm, the sound of another creature being completely at peace

name: Church Organ
onset: The first chord fills the space like water filling a pool — it doesn't arrive, it accumulates.
sustain: A vast, layered wall of sound — pipes of every size contributing their voice, the building itself becoming the instrument's body.
decay: The keys release but the sound persists — the cathedral holds it, lets it ring, the stone walls reluctant to let it go.

prose_fragments: architecture making music, or music making architecture
a sound too large for any other room
the instrument that needed a building built around it
experiential.feel: transcendent, overwhelming, the sound of human engineering reaching for the divine

name: Single Bird Call
onset: A single, clear phrase cuts through the ambient — bright and deliberate, a musical sentence with punctuation.
sustain: The phrase repeats, each iteration slightly varied — the same melody with improvised ornaments.
decay: A final call, unanswered, hangs in the air before the bird falls silent or moves on.

prose_fragments: a voice claiming territory in the key of C sharp
the smallest singer with the biggest reach
a melody that existed before melody had a name
experiential.feel: clear, natural, the sound of wildness persisting in the everyday

name: Dripping Water
onset: A single drop falls and strikes water or stone — a bright, hollow plink.
sustain: Drip. Drip. Drip. Each one identical and separate, the silence between them as much a part of the rhythm as the drops.
decay: It doesn't decay so much as become ignorable — a sound that the brain learns to file under 'not important' until 3 AM.

prose_fragments: water's most patient assault
the sound that carved the Grand Canyon, one drop at a time
a metronome powered by gravity and bad plumbing
experiential.feel: persistent, maddening or meditative depending on your mood

name: Mechanical Typewriter
onset: The first key strikes the platen with a sharp, satisfying clack — metal hitting paper through ribbon.
sustain: A rapid staccato of clacks, punctuated by the zip and ding of the carriage return — the rhythm of thought made mechanical.
decay: The typing stops. The last clack hangs in the air. Then the slow ratchet of the platen as the page is pulled free.

prose_fragments: writing as a percussive act
each letter a committed, physical impression
the sound of words being stamped into existence
experiential.feel: authoritative, nostalgic, the sound of writing when writing was physical work

name: Washing Machine
onset: Water rushes in with a hiss, then the drum begins its slow rotation — a sloshing, churning rhythm.
sustain: Agitate, pause, agitate, pause — the drum turning clothes through soapy water in a patient, mechanical cycle.
decay: The spin cycle winds down from its high whine, the drum slowing, water draining with a gurgle, then the click of completion.

prose_fragments: domesticity on a timer
water and soap and fabric in a mechanical waltz
the sound of chores doing themselves
experiential.feel: domestic, reassuring, the sound of the house taking care of things

name: Dog Barking
onset: A single, sharp bark — the dog's entire opinion compressed into one syllable.
sustain: Bark, bark, bark — each one an exclamation point, the intervals telling you whether it's alarm, excitement, or boredom.
decay: A final bark, then a low grumble, then watchful silence.

prose_fragments: a one-word vocabulary deployed at maximum volume
the original home security system
the sound of a creature that has something to say and only one way to say it
experiential.feel: alert, insistent, the sound of territory being defended or joy being expressed — context is everything

name: Cicadas
onset: One starts — a rising, electric buzz — then another joins, and another, until the air itself vibrates.
sustain: A massive, pulsating drone that seems to come from everywhere at once — the trees themselves buzzing.
decay: As temperature drops, the drone thins. Individual buzzes separate and slow. Night brings silence.

prose_fragments: summer distilled to a single, electric frequency
the sound of heat made audible
a billion tiny machines running at full speed
experiential.feel: overwhelming, summer, the sound of life operating at maximum

name: Helicopter
onset: A distant thud-thud-thud — the blades chopping air, felt before fully heard.
sustain: The heavy, rhythmic percussion of rotors displacing air — thwap-thwap-thwap — vibrating the chest at close range.
decay: The thumping thins as it recedes, each beat softer, until it's just a suggestion on the wind.

prose_fragments: air being beaten into submission
a rhythm that vibrates the rib cage
the sound of something that shouldn't fly, flying
experiential.feel: powerful, urgent, the sound of rotor-powered authority

name: Fluorescent Light Buzz
onset: The tube flickers and buzzes — a thin, electric complaint as the gas ionizes.
sustain: A constant, slightly fluctuating buzz at line frequency — 60 Hz and its harmonics filling every institutional ceiling.
decay: The light goes off with a click and the buzz vanishes, leaving you in silence you didn't know you wanted.

prose_fragments: electricity having a headache
the soundtrack of offices, hospitals, and late-night convenience stores
a sound that exists only to be tuned out
experiential.feel: institutional, draining, the sound of spaces designed for function, not pleasure

name: Wind Through Pine Trees
onset: A low rush builds in the canopy — the needles catching the air and converting it to a deep, sighing wash.
sustain: A continuous, breathing sound — deeper than leaf-rustle, more layered, like distant surf heard through a forest.
decay: The wind eases and the rush softens to a murmur, then to silence punctuated by the occasional creak of a branch.

prose_fragments: the forest breathing through a million needle-thin windpipes
a sound the Japanese call 'matsu-kaze' — pine wind
the oldest continuous music on Earth
experiential.feel: meditative, ancient, the sound of trees conducting an orchestra of air

name: Cough
onset: A sharp, involuntary explosion of air — the body's violent clearing mechanism.
sustain: Almost none — each cough is a single, discrete event, sometimes followed by a chain of diminishing aftershocks.
decay: A ragged inhale, a throat-clearing, then quiet — until the next one.

prose_fragments: the body evicting something it doesn't want
a small explosion in the throat
the sound that makes everyone in the quiet car look up
experiential.feel: involuntary, exposed, the sound of the body reminding you it has opinions

name: Microwave Beep
onset: Beep-beep-beep — three identical, electronic tones announcing completion with zero poetry.
sustain: None — each beep is a short, sharp pulse designed for maximum attention at minimum effort.
decay: The beeps stop, but if you don't respond, they'll repeat in sixty seconds. The machine is patient and petty.

prose_fragments: the least beautiful sound in the kitchen
a machine saying 'your food is done' in the language of robots
domestic urgency distilled to a digital pulse
experiential.feel: functional, mildly annoying, the sound of convenience demanding acknowledgment

name: Children Playing
onset: A shriek of delight — sudden and piercing — then laughter and running feet.
sustain: A chaotic tapestry of shouts, laughter, arguing, and the thud of small bodies in motion — organized by no adult principle.
decay: Voices thin as they're called inside, or as games wind down. A final shout, then the particular quiet of an empty playground.

prose_fragments: energy that hasn't learned to be quiet yet
joy unfiltered and at full volume
the sound of recess — freedom measured in decibels
experiential.feel: alive, chaotic, the sound of being young enough to have nothing to whisper about

name: Glass Breaking
onset: A bright, explosive crack — then the cascade of fragments, each piece ringing as it separates.
sustain: A brief, complex shower of high-frequency tinkles and sharp impacts as the pieces scatter and settle.
decay: A few last fragments tinkle into place. Then silence, and the careful sound of someone not moving their feet.

prose_fragments: order becoming chaos in an instant
a solid thing remembering it's actually fragile
the sound of something that can't be undone
experiential.feel: startling, final, the sound of irreversibility

name: Owl Hooting
onset: A low, round note emerges from the darkness — 'who' — resonant and deliberate.
sustain: The phrase repeats in a slow, measured pattern — each hoot placed with the patience of a night hunter.
decay: The final hoot hangs in the dark air, unanswered, and the silence it leaves is deeper than before.

prose_fragments: the night asking a question in bass tones
a sound that makes the darkness feel inhabited
wisdom wearing feathers and speaking in vowels
experiential.feel: nocturnal, mysterious, the sound of the night's oldest resident

name: Zipper
onset: A quick, ascending rip of tiny metal teeth engaging one by one.
sustain: The briefest sustained sound — a metallic purr as the slider races along the track.
decay: It ends with a small, decisive click at the top. Done.

prose_fragments: closure, literally
a hundred tiny hooks meeting their partners at speed
the most satisfying small mechanism ever invented
experiential.feel: decisive, satisfying, the sound of something being sealed

name: Ice Cracking
onset: A sudden, sharp report — like a gunshot if a gunshot could sound wet and cold.
sustain: The crack propagates — a series of lower groans and pings as stress redistributes through the ice sheet.
decay: A final, eerie singing tone as the ice vibrates at its resonant frequency, then settles.

prose_fragments: frozen water remembering it wants to move
a sound like the earth's bones shifting
the eerie music of thermal stress
experiential.feel: eerie, primal, the sound of a surface you shouldn't trust

name: Spoon Stirring in Cup
onset: The spoon touches the cup's rim — a bright clink — then settles into the liquid.
sustain: A gentle, circular tinkling as metal meets ceramic through liquid — clink, swirl, clink, swirl.
decay: The spoon taps twice on the rim (the universal signal for 'done stirring') and is set down.

prose_fragments: the smallest ritual in the kitchen
sugar being persuaded to dissolve
a circle of sound inside a circle of ceramic
experiential.feel: gentle, ritual, the sound of a small comfort being prepared

name: Train Crossing Bell
onset: The bell starts its relentless ding-ding-ding before the gates even begin to lower.
sustain: A metronomic clang, mechanical and insistent, the same note struck over and over — not music, instruction.
decay: It stops mid-clang as the gates rise. The sudden absence is louder than the bell was.

prose_fragments: the sound of waiting — mechanical patience that will outlast you
each clang a countdown to something enormous passing through
the bell doesn't care if you're in a hurry
experiential.feel: anticipation, forced patience, the approach of something massive

name: Ramen Slurp
onset: A sharp intake — air and broth and noodles drawn upward together.
sustain: The slurp is brief but complete — a full-body commitment to the act of eating.
decay: A small exhale of contentment, steam escaping.

prose_fragments: the sound of food being honored
a slurp is a compliment here — the louder, the better
noodles, broth, and air all arriving at once
experiential.feel: comfort, warmth, permission to be loud about pleasure

name: Chopsticks on Bowl
onset: A light tap as wood meets ceramic — tk, tk.
sustain: Irregular clicking rhythms, chopsticks against bowl rim, the small percussion of eating.
decay: The chopsticks are set down across the bowl with a final soft clack.

prose_fragments: the tiny percussion of a meal in progress
wood on ceramic — the simplest music
each click says: I'm still eating, I'm still here
experiential.feel: domestic, precise, the intimate sounds of sustenance

name: Paper Sliding Door (Shoji)
onset: A soft thunk as the frame lifts from its rest.
sustain: A gentle hiss of wood sliding in wood, the paper whispering against the frame.
decay: A soft clack as the door reaches its stop. Then silence returns, rearranged.

prose_fragments: the quietest door in the world — a whisper of wood on wood
the sound of privacy being given or taken, gently
rooms separated by the weight of paper and the sound of respect
experiential.feel: measured, respectful, the architecture of quietness

name: Bicycle Bell
onset: A bright tring! — small and metallic and impossibly cheerful.
sustain: The ring fades quickly, a tiny bell's tiny resonance.
decay: Gone almost before it started, but it moved you out of the way.

prose_fragments: the happiest warning sound ever invented
tring! — part greeting, part get-out-of-the-way
a sound that belongs to slow mornings and canal-side paths
experiential.feel: cheerful, brief, urban grace

name: Distant Train Horn
onset: It arrives from far away — a low, sustained tone that seems to come from the earth itself.
sustain: A mournful bleat that hangs in the air, Doppler-shifted and softened by distance.
decay: It fades so gradually you're not sure when it stopped and the silence began.

prose_fragments: the loneliest sound in America — a train horn at 2 AM
distance turns the blast into a lullaby
somewhere, something enormous is moving through the dark
experiential.feel: loneliness, distance, the romance of going somewhere else

name: Snow Crunching Underfoot
onset: The first step breaks through the crust — a satisfying crunch that announces your weight.
sustain: Each step a compressed percussion: crunch, crunch, crunch — the pitch varying with temperature.
decay: You stop and the silence rushes in, made deeper by the snow absorbing everything.

prose_fragments: the sound of cold underfoot — the colder it is, the higher the squeak
each step a small destruction of something perfect
your footprints are loud; your standing is silent
experiential.feel: isolated, crisp, the solitude of winter walks

name: Church Choir
onset: A single voice begins, then others join — the sound thickening like dawn light.
sustain: Voices braided together, harmonics reinforcing harmonics, the stone walls adding their reverb like a blessing.
decay: The final chord hangs in the air, sustained by the room long after the voices stop.

prose_fragments: the human voice multiplied until it becomes architecture
harmonics stacked so high they stop being notes and become feeling
the sound fills the building and the building fills the sound
experiential.feel: transcendent, communal, the vibration in your sternum that means something

name: Muezzin Call to Prayer
onset: Allahu Akbar — the call begins mid-phrase, as if the silence before was the real interruption.
sustain: The voice winds through microtonal melisma, each phrase rising and falling like breath made visible.
decay: The final note stretches, thins, and dissolves into the city noise it briefly conquered.

prose_fragments: a voice that treats the sky as its ceiling
the call reaches into every window, under every door — you can't not hear it
five times a day, the city pauses and a single voice reminds it why
experiential.feel: devotion, routine transcendence, the sound of a city's soul

name: Temple Bell
onset: The striker meets bronze and the sound is born already enormous.
sustain: A deep, complex tone — fundamental and overtones shifting against each other as the bell vibrates.
decay: The decay lasts impossibly long, thinning from boom to hum to a vibration you feel more than hear.

prose_fragments: one strike, and the silence afterward is a different silence than before
the bell's voice is older than the bell
bronze remembering the moment of impact for a full minute afterward
experiential.feel: contemplative, ancient, a sound that resets time

name: Wind Through Bamboo
onset: A breeze finds the grove and the bamboo begins to talk — clicks and hollow tones.
sustain: Stalks knock against each other in random percussion while the wind hums through the hollows like breath through a flute.
decay: The wind drops and the bamboo settles, one last click, then vegetable silence.

prose_fragments: nature's wind chimes — random, percussive, perfect
hollow wood singing hollow notes
the bamboo grove is an instrument the wind plays badly and beautifully
experiential.feel: peaceful, organic, the sound of a garden breathing

name: Boiling Kettle Whistle
onset: A faint hiss that builds into a wobbling whistle, steam finding its voice.
sustain: The whistle steadies into a shrill, insistent note — a domestic siren demanding attention.
decay: Lifted from the heat, the whistle drops in pitch like a tiny deflating scream.

prose_fragments: water announcing its transformation
the most domestic alarm clock — tea is ready, the world can wait
a pitch that evolved specifically to be impossible to ignore
experiential.feel: domestic urgency, comfort, the ritual of hot water

name: Page Turning
onset: A fingertip catches the corner, the page lifts.
sustain: A brief whisper of paper against paper — shhhf.
decay: The page settles on its fellows with a tiny puff of trapped air.

prose_fragments: the quietest form of progress
shhhf — the sound of someone else's concentration
paper measuring time in chapters
experiential.feel: contemplative, intimate, the quiet industry of reading

name: Pencil on Paper
onset: The pencil touches paper and begins its soft rasping journey.
sustain: A gentle, irregular scratching — skritch, skritch — graphite giving itself to the page.
decay: The pencil lifts. A brief silence. Then it returns.

prose_fragments: thought becoming visible, one scratch at a time
the friction of creation — graphite surrendering to paper
the sound of someone working something out
experiential.feel: focused, creative, the intimacy of handwriting

name: Match Striking
onset: The scratch — sharp, brief — and then a small explosion of phosphorus light.
sustain: The initial flare settles into a tiny, wavering flame. The sulfur smell arrives.
decay: The match burns down or is shaken out — a wisp of smoke the only evidence.

prose_fragments: friction into fire — the oldest magic
scratch-flare-settle: three acts in two seconds
the brief drama of controlled combustion
experiential.feel: ritual, deliberate, the small ceremony of making fire

name: Heartbeat in Silence
onset: In the silence, you become aware of it — the bass drum you've been ignoring your whole life.
sustain: Thub-dub, thub-dub — the sound of your own machinery, relentless and reassuring and slightly terrifying.
decay: You stop noticing it again, which is its own kind of miracle.

prose_fragments: the sound you hear when all other sounds leave
your body reminding you it's still working
the metronome that started before you were born and will stop when you do
experiential.feel: primal, vulnerable, alone with yourself

name: Tinnitus Ring
onset: It doesn't start. It was always there. You just noticed it again.
sustain: A thin, high-frequency tone — eeeeee — that exists only inside your head.
decay: It doesn't decay. It's masked by other sounds, but never gone.

prose_fragments: the sound of hearing itself — the nervous system humming at idle
a frequency only you can hear, your private soundtrack to silence
the ring that makes true silence impossible
experiential.feel: isolated, internal, the loneliness of a sound no one else hears
